resources.title: Capstone README Template
resources.description: A fill-in-the-blanks README skeleton matching exactly what Lesson 7's wrap-up checklist asks for — summary, architecture, what's deliberately simplified, test coverage, security-review results, deployed/verified addresses, and a frontend link or local-run instructions. Reuse it for all three capstone projects; a reviewer recognizing the same honest structure across your portfolio is a feature, not a repetition problem.

resources.title: Self-Review Security Checklist
resources.description: The six-item checklist from Lesson 6 (reentrancy, overflow/underflow, first-depositor/division-by-zero, access control, slippage/front-running, rounding), generalized into a reusable template with a column for your own findings and a column for whether each item applies to the contract at hand. Pair it with Lesson 21's five-step reading method when something doesn't apply cleanly — not every project has every risk, and saying so explicitly is itself the honest deliverable.

resources.title: Hardhat Ignition Deployment Module Template
resources.description: A generalized version of Lesson 7's `SimplePoolDeployment` Ignition module — the dependency-ordered `m.contract(...)` pattern, plus the `hardhat keystore` secret-storage commands and the `verify` call that makes an address actually worth sharing. Swap in your own contract names and constructor arguments for whichever project you're deploying.

resources.title: DAO Deployment & Role-Handoff Script
resources.description: The exact five-step deployment order from Lesson 16 (token, then timelock, then Governor, then role grants, then the deployer's own admin-role renunciation) as a copy-paste Hardhat/Foundry script skeleton, with the renounce step left impossible to accidentally skip — it's the first line after the role grants, not an optional cleanup step at the end.
